title: Constraint: 90° Rotated Matrix
constraints: Runs on Verilator with the z3 solver (`sudo pacman -S z3`).
hints: Rotation is just an index mapping, written as one equality per element.
Clockwise: the first row of `b` is the first column of `a`, read bottom-up.
Distinctness: compare each pair once (order pairs by flattened index).

examples.check: all elements of a are distinct
examples.title: distinct
